changes.comment: A share link opened in a browser that already has a vault can now land the folder inside that vault: the join page offers "Inside <vault>" (with a picker when there are several) and a folder named after the link, and opens the vault or hands the join to the tab that already has it. "As a shared vault of its own" now says that everything in such a vault is shared, and a vault opened from a share carries a "Shared with you" badge and a "This whole vault" row in the Shared view. A browser vault opens in one tab at a time; a second tab is told it is open elsewhere instead of silently overwriting edits. The default keyboard shortcuts no longer take keys the editor or the browser already use (Ctrl/Cmd+Arrows, Ctrl/Cmd+[ and ], zoom keys): Back and Forward are Obsidian's Ctrl+Alt+Arrows, split right is Ctrl/Cmd+\, and the sidebars, daily notes, delete, move and the pane verbs are palette rows until a keymap binds them. The app is spelled "Oh Hi markdown" everywhere. The opening splash draws the landing site's wordmark: "Oh Hi" on the highlighter, then "markdown".
